SELECT pts.id, pts.name, pts.type, case when pts.distribution_type = 0 then pts.role_name when pts.distribution_type = 1 then pts.charge_name else '' end as charge_name, COALESCE((SELECT name FROM project_task_sys t WHERE t.id=pts.pre_task_id ),'') preTaskName, pts.pre_task_id, pts.plan_start_time, pts.plan_end_time, pts.priority, COALESCE(spp.name,'') AS phaseName, pts.description, pts.is_fixed, pts.create_user_id, pts.create_user_name, pts.create_time FROM project_task_sys pts left join sys_project_phase spp on pts.phase_id = spp.id
AND pts.name LIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword},'%')
AND spp.name = '立项阶段'
AND spp.name != '立项阶段'
ORDER BY create_time asc
SELECT sd.name,ps.id FROM sys_docs_name sd JOIN task_delivery_docs td ON sd.id=td.docs_name_id JOIN project_task_sys ps ON ps.id=td.task_id
